summary.text: Esther Panitch is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 51 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney who owns The Panitch Law Group PC, she succeeded Josh McLaurin in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Panitch was born in North Miami, Florida, and lives in Sandy Springs, Georgia.
She earned a bachelor's degree and a juris doctor from the University of Miami in 1992 and 1995.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she moved to Georgia in 2004 and opened a private firm in Atlanta representing criminal defendants and victims, and that she practices civil and family law.
She has been affiliated with Hadassah, and her career experience includes owning The Panitch Law Group PC.
Panitch defeated Peter Korman in the 2022 general election for District 51, assuming office on January 9, 2023, and defeated Keith Gettmann in the 2024 general election.
She defeated Aaron Baker in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Gettmann again in the general election.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Judiciary Juvenile Committee, the Judiciary - Non-Civil Committee and the Public Safety and Homeland Security Committee.
In the same 2022 survey, Panitch listed her key messages as protecting voting rights, rebuilding infrastructure, enhancing public transportation and affordable, quality healthcare.
